summaries: • 20MICRONS (SAST): Executive Summary: 20 Microns Limited experienced a return to revenue growth in Q2 FY27 (+3.2% YoY) and expanded its H1 gross margin by 79 bps due to a richer product mix. However, this was materially offset by declines in H1 EBITDA (-5.5%) and PAT (-8.3%), primarily from absorbing higher energy and freight costs, which compressed operating margins. The company is strategically addressing this by investing ₹100 Cr in capacity expansion for specialty products, acquiring captive mines for supply security, and pursuing operational efficiencies. └ 📄 Source

• 20MICRONS (SAST): Executive Summary: 20 Microns Limited has announced the reaffirmation of its credit ratings by CRISIL Ratings for its ₹117 crore bank loan facilities, maintaining 'CRISIL A / Stable' for long-term and 'CRISIL A1' for short-term debt. This stable outlook reflects the company's established market position, sound operating efficiency, experienced promoters, and healthy financial risk profile, indicating consistent financial stability with no immediate red flags. The reaffirmation ensures continued confidence in the company's debt servicing capabilities. └ 📄 Source

• 20MICRONS (Results): Here is a 2-3 sentence executive summary of the financial document: 20 Microns Limited reported a return to revenue growth in Q2 FY27 and improved H1 gross margins, yet experienced a material decline in H1 EBITDA (-5.5%) and PAT (-8.3%), primarily due to elevated energy and freight costs. While the company maintains a strong balance sheet and is executing strategic investments, including a ₹100 Cr capacity expansion into specialty products and captive mine acquisitions, the immediate red flag is the failure to translate top-line and gross margin improvements into operating profit growth. Management aims to recover operating margins in H2 through pricing and efficiency, alongside securing raw material supply and leveraging positive tailwinds like the anti-dumping duty on TiO2. └ 📄 Source

• AARON (Presentations & PR): Aaron Industries Limited demonstrated robust Q2FY27 results, exhibiting strong year-on-year growth in revenue, EBITDA, and PAT, driven by its vertically integrated elevator and stainless steel divisions. Key takeaways include successful market penetration for new home lift products and enhanced manufacturing efficiency from recent capital investments, positioning the company to capitalize on significant industry tailwinds. However, a material increase in "Other Assets" on the balance sheet alongside rising borrowings warrants closer examination to understand potential working capital implications. └ 📄 Source

• AARON (Presentations & PR): Aaron Industries Limited reported exceptionally strong financial results for Q2 and H1 FY27, with revenue growing over 20% year-on-year and net profit more than doubling, reflecting significant margin expansion. This robust performance is primarily driven by impressive growth in both its Elevator and Stainless Steel Polishing Divisions, the latter expanding by over 70%. The company maintains a healthy growth momentum supported by strategic investments and improved operational efficiencies, with no immediate red flags identified in the reported financials. └ 📄 Source

• AARON (Results): Aaron Industries Limited reported robust financial performance for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, with revenue from operations increasing approximately 24% year-on-year for the half-year period. Net profit surged over 121% year-on-year for the half-year, significantly benefiting from a substantially lower deferred tax expense compared to the prior year. The accompanying unaudited financial results received a clean limited review report from the auditors, indicating no material misstatements. └ 📄 Source

• AARTIIND (Presentations & PR): Aarti Industries Limited delivered robust financial results for Q2 FY27, achieving record quarterly revenue (₹3,887 crore, +73% YoY) and EBITDA (₹418 crore, +44% YoY), driven by over 30% volume growth and strong export demand. The company is strategically positioned for sustained future growth with the commissioning of Zone IV and a new 10-year manufacturing agreement valued at ₹1,500 crore. While high raw material costs led to suppressed EBITDA margins, these were effectively passed through to customers, protecting absolute EBITDA and indicating a strong outlook leveraging favorable global trade dynamics. └ 📄 Source

• AARTIIND (Results): Executive Summary: Aarti Industries Limited reported strong unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, demonstrating significant year-on-year and sequential growth in both revenue and net profit.
